scope: Local performance audit of the packaged native Catnight board and riding yard; separate production-bundle Chromium audit of the full reference island. Native live-island migration and Steam online remain incomplete.

method.nativeConfiguration: Development, default Epic scalability (3), render scale 100%, DX12 SM5, RTX 4050
method.nativeWindowVerification: Win32 client rectangle per capture; uncapped PNG back buffers are 1920x1080. ForceRes and r.SetRes required.
method.nativeProfiler: Synchronous CSV processing; async CSV mode produced exit 777003 after shutdown, while unprofiled and synchronous captures exited 0.
method.nativeTargets: 60-FPS capped and separate uncapped runs; r.VSync=0; no fixed timestep for performance.
method.browser: Chromium 151 headless, DPR=1, full island canvas smaller than window; GPU queries enabled; local assets; audio muted.
method.wallpaper: Paused for final performance captures, restored after checks.
limits: One laptop, Balanced power mode, hidden native windows / headless Chromium; engine/page timings rather than monitor-present latency.
Fresh processes with warm OS/driver caches; no cold-PC or Shipping-build certification.
Five-minute soaks cannot prove absence of long-duration leaks.
Fixed 10/60/144 Hz physics checks do not measure rendered FPS.
Native Steam/network, physical gamepad, mobile, other machines and the old CEF wrapper were not performance-certified.
method.discarded: Preliminary native grid requested 1080p but remained 1280x720; excluded from final metrics.

validation.visualReview: Current crouch and rear-riding captures reviewed; complete route validation passed.
validation.browserRtx: All four scenario groups completed; saved results contain travel, 44 view samples, five soak minutes, 20 visits, 2D scenarios and 14 village/interior samples. Observed runner status passed; PowerShell supervisor misclassified stderr warning.

findings.finding: Island entry stalls the main thread
findings.evidence: RTX first entry 3603 ms; longest main-thread task 2124 ms, local downloads complete at 134 ms. Repeat entry median 2424 ms.
findings.next: Profile and split island initialization; measure again without changing visual quality.

findings.finding: Instant bot pacing depends on frame cap
findings.evidence: 1080p capped fast match: 21.167% late frames, p95 23.0133 ms. Uncapped fast match: 87.28 FPS, p95 12.9261 ms, 0% over the late-frame threshold.
findings.next: Investigate limiter/presentation scheduling with bursty action/render updates; do not call this a general lack of 60-FPS rendering capacity.

findings.finding: Integrated GPU cannot sustain Full island effects
findings.evidence: Intel UHD Full wheat 31 FPS, forest edge 40 FPS at a 1440x900 window. Lite/75% wheat 36.5 FPS and forest edge 38.5 FPS still miss 60.
findings.next: Prefer the tested RTX 4050 for Full effects; reduce foliage/draw and pixel costs before declaring Intel support at 60 FPS.

findings.evidence: After forced GC, first to twentieth exit rises from 13.56 to 17.81 MiB. Last ten visits still rise about 1.4 MiB. No orphan WebGL draws or context warnings.
findings.next: Take heap snapshots and attribute game, benchmark, browser and cache retention; this is a growth signal, not proof of a game-only leak.

findings.finding: Flat chart retains the native 3D world
findings.evidence: Chart toggle only changes Slate view/paint state; game mode does not disable board/world rendering for flat mode. GPU counters remain close to 3D.
findings.next: Measure an A/B that suspends obscured world rendering before choosing an optimization.
